message: I remember the last big storm that blew through. Our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree—my son was sharing his latest weather app screenshot, my daughter was sending memes of cats in raincoats, and I was busy reminding everyone to check their flashlights. It was a lovely distraction from the wind howling outside. Who knew a little storm prep could come with such a side of humor? Sometimes, chatting with loved ones is the best way to weather any storm. 🌧️
